definition_notes: Harvard's CDS B1 covers the degree-granting schools: Harvard College, GSAS and the professional schools (Business, Dental, Design, Divinity, Education, Government, Law, Medical, Public Health). It does NOT include the Harvard Extension School. The IPEDS EF total for Fall 2023 (30,386) is ~30% larger. Harvard OIRA 2023-24 Fact Book (opened; https://oira.harvard.edu/2023-24-fact-book/2023-24-fact-book-enrollment/) shows Fall 2023 degree-student headcount of 24,596 for the University (Oct 15, 2023), which includes Extension School degree candidates (692 undergraduate + 2,903 graduate = 3,595); 24,596 less 3,595 = 21,001, close to the CDS 21,278 (School rows overlap for cross-registered students, so it is only approximate). The remaining ~5,800 between 24,596 and IPEDS 30,386 is presumably non-degree/other students (mainly Extension) that the Fact Book excludes; that last step is an inference, not shown in a document I opened.
caveats: Large definitional gap vs IPEDS (-30.0%): CDS excludes Harvard Extension School students. Decide with Brett whether to use the CDS (degree schools, ~21.2K) or a broader count (24.6K degree incl. Extension, or IPEDS 30K incl. non-degree).
